items.title: OpenAI’s cozy partner Cerebras is on track for a blockbuster IPO
items.description: AI chip maker Cerebras is heading for a blockbuster IPO that could value it at $26.6 billion or more. It's relationship with OpenAI is deep and rich.
items.tldr: AIチップメーカーのCerebrasが、OpenAIとの深い関係を背景に266億ドル以上の評価が期待される大規模なIPOを目指しています。

items.title: Single Agent vs Multi-Agent: When to Build a Multi-Agent System
items.description: A practical guide to understanding AI agent design, ReAct workflows, and when to scale from a single agent to a multi-agent system. The post Single Agent vs Multi-Agent: When to Build a Multi-Agent System appeared first on Towards Data Science.
items.tldr: AIエージェントの設計やReActワークフローについての実用的なガイドであり、単一エージェントからマルチエージェントシステムにスケールアップするタイミングを解説しています。

items.title: Image AI models now drive app growth, beating chatbot upgrades
items.description: Appfigures finds visual model launches generate 6.5x more downloads — but most don’t convert that spike into revenue.
items.tldr: 画像AIモデルの導入がアプリの成長を促進し、チャットボットのアップグレードを上回るが、ダウンロードの急増を収益に結びつけることができていない。

items.title: How to Build an Efficient Knowledge Base for AI Models
items.description: Building a knowledge base for AI models isn’t a one-time task but an iterative process of refinement. The post How to Build an Efficient Knowledge Base for AI Models appeared first on Towards Data Science.
items.tldr: AIモデルのための知識ベースの構築は一度きりの作業ではなく、継続的な改善プロセスである。

items.description: Musk texted OpenAI's president and co-founder saying that he and CEO Sam Altman "will be the most hated men in America" if OpenAI doesn't settle the suit.

items.description: Sam Altman and Elon Musk are facing off in a high-stakes trial that could alter the future of OpenAI and its most well-known product, ChatGPT. items.title: Reduce friction and latency for long-running jobs with Webhooks in Gemini API

items.title: How AI Tools Generate Technical Debt in IoT Systems — and What to Do About It
items.description: AI tools speed up IoT development — but closer to the hardware, the same code that looks correct can silently break thousands of devices at once. The post How AI Tools Generate Technical Debt in IoT Systems — and What to Do About It appeared first on Towards Data Science.
items.tldr: AIツールはIoT開発を加速させるが、ハードウェアに近い部分では正しく見えるコードが一度に多数のデバイスを破損させる可能性があり、技術的負債を生む原因となる。
